message: I bought the photo editing licence (ORD-1066) but I don't need it anymore.

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, customer_id, order_date, delivery_date, product_name, category, unit_price, quantity, order_total, payment_method, status, final_sale FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.orders WHERE customer_id = 'C010' AND order_id = 'ORD-1066'
SELECT refund_id, customer_id, order_id, request_date, amount, reason, decision FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_history WHERE customer_id = 'C010'
SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.refundwise.refundwise_usl.refund_policy WHERE category = 'Digital' OR category = 'ALL'

rows.rule_text: Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Digital products (licences, downloads) are non-refundable once delivered, unless the product does not work.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Order ORD-1066 is a Digital product (Photo Editing Software Licence) that was delivered on 2026-10-18 per E1. The reason is changed_mind, not that the product does not work, so R6 applies and digital products are non-refundable once delivered unless defective. Order total $39.00 is under the auto-approve limit, already_refunded is false, and there are no prior refunds per E2, but R6 still governs.

critique.reason: All factual claims are supported: E1 confirms ORD-1066 is Digital, delivered 2026-10-18, total $39.00; E2 confirms no prior refunds; E3 contains R6 (Digital, delivered, non-refundable unless it does not work, outcome reject). Python checks agree: category Digital, delivered true, already_refunded false, over_auto_limit false. Reason is changed_mind, not defective/does-not-work, so R6 governs and reject is correct.

customer_reply: Thank you for reaching out. I'm sorry to inform you that refunds for digital product licences are not available once delivered, unless the product is defective or does not work as described. Since your order ORD-1066 was delivered and the reason is a change of mind, this falls under our non-refundable policy for digital items.
limitations: Could not verify actual product functionality beyond the customer's claim; no defect was reported or documented.
